description: The net price Liffey Metals pays today, in euro per gram of the item, for one metal and carat or fineness, with the spot quote time (spotAsOf), the basis and the deductions in plain English. Give the seller's county to add that county's postal arrangement and page. Omit carat for every grade of the metal. Same figures as https://liffeymetals.com/prices.

carat.description: Carat, hallmark fineness number or grade word, e.g. 9, '18ct', 750, 'sterling', 925. Omit for every grade of the metal.

county.description: Optional county, as a slug or name: 'cork', 'County Cork', 'Co. Antrim'. Adds that county's postal arrangement and page.

name: get_buy_price
title: Buy price per gram for one metal and carat
